title: East Nashville Retreat- Steps to Parks & Cafés
description:
Enjoy late summer and early fall in East Nashville from this stylish 3-bedroom retreat. Explore nearby coffee shops, restaurants, bars, and neighborhood favorites, with downtown Nashville just minutes away. An open layout, comfortable modern spaces, free parking, and pet-friendly accommodations make it easy to settle in and enjoy your stay.

The space
Guests have full access to the entire home. We offer three full bedrooms. Our master has a King bed with a full bathroom, walk in shower and walk in closet. Our two guest bedrooms have  full closets and full bathrooms. We have a full kitchen stocked with drink ware, serve ware and a Keurig coffee machine. 

Other things to note:
There is an active train track near the property. The train should not blow its whistle, but the tracks do make noise. These are commercial trains and schedules are out of our control/visibility.

Guest access
Guests will enter the home from the garage door keypad.
